title: Chapter XIII
chineseTitle: 第 13 章：数星星的商人

paragraphs.en: The little prince approached a businessman who was engrossed in his calculations. "Good morning," he said, "your cigarette has gone out."
paragraphs.zh: 小王子走近一个正全神贯注于计算的商人。“早上好，”他说，“你的烟头灭了。”

paragraphs.en: "Three and two make five," the businessman replied without looking up. "Five and seven make twelve... I haven't time to light it again."
paragraphs.zh: “三加二等于五，”商人头也不抬地回答，“五加七等于十二……我没时间再点一次。”

paragraphs.en: "Five hundred million what?" the little prince persisted.
paragraphs.zh: “五亿什么？”小王子坚持问道。

paragraphs.en: The businessman finally looked up. "During my fifty-four years here, I was only disturbed three times. Twenty-two years ago, a goose fell from the sky; eleven years ago, rheumatism struck; and now...
paragraphs.zh: 商人终于抬起头来。“在这五十四个年头里，我只被打扰了三次。二十二年前，一只鹅从天而降；十一年前，风湿病找上了门；而现在……”

paragraphs.en: five-hundred-and-one millions of those objects in the sky."
paragraphs.zh: “天空中有五百零一个那样的东西。”

paragraphs.en: "Millions of what?" the little prince asked again.
paragraphs.zh: “几百万什么？”小王子又问了一遍。

paragraphs.en: The businessman realized he couldn't avoid answering. "Millions of stars," he said. "I am concerned with matters of consequence: I must be accurate."
paragraphs.zh: 商人意识到他无法回避这个问题，“成千上万的星星，”他说，“我关注的是事关重大的事务：必须准确无误。”

paragraphs.en: "And what do you do with these stars?"
paragraphs.zh: “那你把这些星星怎么办？”

paragraphs.en: "Nothing, I own them."
paragraphs.zh: “这些我都有。”他脱口而出。

paragraphs.en: "You own the stars?" the little prince repeated.
paragraphs.zh: “你拥有星星吗？”小王子又问了一遍。

paragraphs.en: "Yes, but kings reign over them; it's different for me. Owning the stars makes me rich, and being rich allows me to buy more if any are discovered," the businessman concluded.
paragraphs.zh: “是的，但国王可以统治他们；对我来说就不一样。拥有星辰让我变得富有，而富有则让我能够购买更多的星星，如果还有的话。”商人总结道。

paragraphs.en: The little prince mused, "This man reasons a bit like my poor tippler." He had more questions, though.
paragraphs.zh: 小王子沉思道：“这个人思考的方式有点像我那个可怜的酒鬼。”不过他还有更多的问题想要问。

paragraphs.en: "How can one own the stars?" he asked.
paragraphs.zh: “谁能拥有星辰？”他脱口问道。

paragraphs.en: "Who owns them?" the businessman retorted irritably. "Nobody."
paragraphs.zh: “它们归谁所有？”商人不耐烦地反问道，“没人拥有。”

paragraphs.en: "Then they belong to you," the little prince said, "since you were the first to think of it."
paragraphs.zh: “那么他们就归你了，”小王子说，“因为你最先想到了这一点。”

paragraphs.en: "Is that all?"
paragraphs.zh: “就这些吗？”

paragraphs.en: "Certainly. If you find a diamond or an island, it's yours. Same with ideas—owning one gives you rights."
paragraphs.zh: 当然。如果你发现了钻石或一座岛屿，那就是你的了。同样的道理也适用于思想——拥有一个想法就赋予你相应的权利。

paragraphs.en: The businessman explained.
paragraphs.zh: 商人解释道。

paragraphs.en: The little prince nodded, then asked, "But if I owned a silk scarf, I could wear it and take it away. What can I do with the stars?"
paragraphs.zh: 小王子点了点头，然后问道：“但如果我拥有一条丝巾，我可以戴上它并带走。而星星我能做什么呢？”

paragraphs.en: "You can bank them," the businessman replied. "Write their number on paper, put it in a drawer, and lock it."
paragraphs.zh: “你可以把它们存起来，”商人回答，“把他们的账号写下来，记在纸上，放进抽屉里锁好。”

paragraphs.en: "That's all?"
paragraphs.zh: “就是这些吗？”

paragraphs.en: "Enough for me," said the businessman.
paragraphs.zh: “够了，”商人说道。

paragraphs.en: The little prince thought, "Entertaining but not very useful." He continued his conversation: "I own a flower I water daily, three volcanoes I clean weekly. Owning them is useful to both.
paragraphs.zh: 小王子心想：“有趣但不太实用。”他继续说道：“我有一朵花每天浇水，还有三座火山每周清理。拥有它们对我俩都有益处。”

paragraphs.en: But you are useless to the stars."
paragraphs.zh: 但是对你来说，对星星而言你是毫无用处的。

paragraphs.en: The businessman was speechless. The little prince walked away, muttering, "Grown-ups are indeed strange," as he carried on his journey.
paragraphs.zh: 商人惊得说不出话来。小王子喃喃自语道：“大人们真是奇怪，”然后继续他的旅程。
